scheme_name: Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students of Other Backward Classes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India after Secondary Level (Except Class XI & XII)
description:
The Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students of Other Backward Classes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India after Secondary Level was launched by the Government of India in 2017. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) from the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to promote higher education among OBC students. 

The government seeks to reduce the financial burden on these students by providing them with additional scholarships. 

The scheme specifically targets students pursuing higher studies after completing their secondary education. 

Eligible courses include diploma courses, undergraduate degrees, and postgraduate degrees. 

However, the scheme does not cover students pursuing Class XI and Class XII. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is structured to support students in various fields of education. 

The scholarship amount is set at INR 20,000 per annum for students enrolled in degree courses. 

For students pursuing diploma courses, the scholarship amount is INR 10,000 per annum. 

The scholarship is intended to cover expenses such as tuition fees, books, and other educational materials. 

The scheme is applicable to students who have completed their secondary education from recognized institutions. 

To be eligible for the scholarship, students must belong to the OBC category as defined by the Government of India. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at INR 2.5 lakh per annum for the family. 

Students must also be residents of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. 

The application process for the scholarship is straightforward. 

Students must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs. 

The application form requires personal details such as name, address, and educational qualifications. 

Students must also provide proof of their OBC status through a caste certificate. 

Additionally, a family income certificate must be submitted to verify eligibility. 

The completed application form along with the required documents must be submitted to the designated authority in their respective districts. 

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set at the beginning of the academic year. 

Students are advised to check the official website for specific dates related to application submission. 

Once the applications are submitted, they are reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Eligible students are then notified about the scholarship award. 

The disbursement of scholarship funds is usually done through direct bank transfer. 

This ensures that the funds reach the students directly without any intermediaries. 

The scholarship is renewable every year based on the student's academic performance. 

Students must maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in their classes to remain eligible for renewal. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India. 

The ministry is responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of funds. 

Students can contact the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for any queries related to the scholarship. 

The contact details for the ministry are available on their official website. 

This scheme is part of a larger initiative by the Government of India to promote education among marginalized communities. 

The government recognizes the importance of education in improving the socio-economic status of OBC students. 

By providing financial assistance, the scheme aims to encourage more students to pursue higher education. 

This initiative is also aligned with the government's goal of achieving 30% Gross Enrollment Ratio in higher education by 2025. 

The scheme has seen a positive response since its inception. 

Many students from the Andaman and Nicobar Islands have benefited from the financial support provided. 

The scholarship has enabled students to enroll in various prestigious institutions across India. 

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The scholarship is a crucial step towards achieving educational equity among OBC students. 

It addresses the financial barriers that often hinder students from pursuing higher studies. 

The scheme also contributes to the overall development of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands by enhancing the educational qualifications of its youth. 

In conclusion, the Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students of Other Backward Classes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India after Secondary Level is a significant initiative. 

It provides essential financial support to OBC students, enabling them to pursue their academic aspirations. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to promoting education and empowering marginalized communities. 

Students are encouraged to take advantage of this opportunity to further their education. 

For more information about the scheme, students can visit the official website of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs. 

This will provide them with the latest updates and detailed guidelines regarding the application process. 

The scheme is a vital resource for OBC students in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. 

It plays a crucial role in shaping their future and contributing to the nation’s development. 

The government remains dedicated to ensuring that every eligible student has access to higher education opportunities. 

This scheme is a testament to that commitment.
